# Provenance

This rule originates from an incident on 2026-07-19 in which the `deploy-staging` job restored a stale cache entry after the lockfile changed without triggering a cache miss (Source 2, 14:07). The oncall engineer initially observed that staging was serving last week's build (Source 2, 14:02), and the root cause was identified approximately 25 minutes later: the cache key was keyed only on branch name and did not include the lockfile hash (Source 1 and Source 2, 14:31). Adding the lockfile hash to the cache key resolved the issue (Source 2, 14:31), though the outage consumed roughly 40 minutes of investigation time (Source 2, 14:44). This was the first observed occurrence of this failure mode in the deployment pipeline (Source 2, 14:44).
